data.text: Before we head out, how about we agree to catch 10 tons each this month? That leaves 50 tons to double back to 100, so we can each earn $10,000 a month without running down the lake. My family has fished here for years, and I want our village to keep making a living from it. Let’s check the reported catches together each month and agree on the next month’s limits before fishing. John, would you be willing to stick to 10 tons?
